faq_heading: Homes near Mennonite Educational Institute: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Mennonite Educational Institute get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Mennonite Educational Institute is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Mennonite Educational Institute home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Mennonite Educational Institute, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Mennonite Educational Institute sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 99 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,135,000, townhomes $660,000, condos $480,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Mennonite Educational Institute?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Mennonite Educational Institute the median was 26 days on the market, closing at 97.2% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 99 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Mennonite Educational Institute?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Harry Sayers Elementary (1.0 km south-west), Clearbrook Elementary (1.2 km south-east) and Rick Hansen Secondary (1.4 km south-west).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Mennonite Educational Institute in the listing, then check the sold prices within 2 km of the school.
How the Mennonite Educational Institute search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Mennonite Educational Institute, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
